info.name: Start Feature
info.desc: Initial page for resume creation with two options: start from scratch or upload existing resume. Optimized for mobile devices with responsive design and compact layout.

feature.folder_structure: /features/start ├── components/ │ └── StartOptions.tsx # Component with two choice cards (mobile-optimized, compact) ├── StartPage.tsx # Main start page (mobile-optimized, no logo on mobile) ├── startApi.ts # API for file upload and session creation └── spec.xml # This file

component.name: StartPage
component.desc: Main page with header and centered options, optimized for mobile

feature.name: responsive_padding
feature.desc: Adaptive padding based on screen size

feature.name: flexible_height
feature.desc: Min-height instead of fixed height for better mobile experience

feature.name: header_aware_layout
feature.desc: Calculates available space considering header height

feature.name: no_logo_mobile
feature.desc: Logo is hidden on mobile devices to save space

component.name: StartOptions
component.desc: Two cards for choosing resume creation method, mobile-optimized and compact

prop.name: onGuardStartFromScratch?
prop.desc: Optional guard callback; return false to prevent action (e.g., open paywall)

prop.name: onGuardUploadResume?
prop.desc: Optional guard callback; return false to prevent file picker (e.g., open paywall)

prop.name: onUploadTaskCreated?
prop.desc: Called with Celery task ID after upload starts so parent can begin polling

event.name: onUploadResume
event.desc: Handle file upload, notify parent about task ID, wait for status before navigation

feature.name: vertical_layout
feature.desc: Cards stack vertically on mobile devices

feature.name: touch_optimized
feature.desc: Larger touch targets and touch feedback

feature.name: mobile_hover
feature.desc: Disabled hover effects on mobile, added active states

feature.name: compact_cards
feature.desc: Reduced card heights and spacing for mobile (160px vs 250px desktop)

feature.name: smaller_icons
feature.desc: Reduced icon sizes on mobile (40px vs 56px desktop)

feature.name: compact_typography
feature.desc: Smaller font sizes and tighter line spacing on mobile

feature.name: reduced_padding
feature.desc: Minimal padding and margins for compact mobile layout

optimization.name: layout
optimization.desc: Vertical card stacking on mobile, horizontal on desktop

optimization.name: touch_targets
optimization.desc: Minimum 40px height for buttons and interactive elements

optimization.name: spacing
optimization.desc: Reduced padding and margins on smaller screens

optimization.name: typography
optimization.desc: Scalable font sizes based on screen size (0.8rem mobile, 1rem desktop)

optimization.name: interactions
optimization.desc: Touch feedback instead of hover effects on mobile

optimization.name: logo_hiding
optimization.desc: Logo hidden on mobile devices to maximize content space

optimization.name: compact_cards
optimization.desc: Reduced card heights: 160px mobile, 200px tablet, 250px desktop

endpoint.name: uploadResume
endpoint.desc: Upload existing resume file and create resume
endpoint.response: Resume object with id, title, template_id, etc.

endpoint.name: startFromScratch
endpoint.desc: Create new resume with default template
endpoint.response: Resume object with id and other fields

flow.name: start_from_scratch
flow.desc: Navigate to /builder after creating resume; if user already has resumes, StartPage shows PaywallModal and blocks action via guard

flow.name: upload_resume
flow.desc: StartPage uploads file, polls /resume/upload/status/{task_id} until state ANALYZING, then redirects to /refine?analyzing=true&taskId={task_id}; any FAILURE stops polling and surfaces an error message

dep.name: Material-UI
dep.purpose: UI components, icons, and responsive breakpoints

dep.name: Shared Header
dep.purpose: Common header component with mobile logo hiding
